caption:
Never tried color by number? This one teaches you first. 🍂

My autumn book starts with learner pages: 10 color by number pages for adults and 15 for kids. Once you've got the hang of it, practice your colors on 65 autumn line-art scenes with pumpkins, falling leaves, acorns and cozy corners.

It's an 80-page print-ready PDF plus high-resolution PNG files. US Letter 8.5 x 11 in, and it prints edge to edge at 100%. Instant digital download.
